Browser profile configuration persists and reuses browser state across crawl sessions

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { browser: { mode: "always" }, browserProfile: "test-profile" };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
